subject: Re: Security deep-dive request — SOC 2 / encryption / audit logs / SSO
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@horizonhealth.com
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Security deep-dive request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Hi Tessa,

We’ve been reviewing Redwood for our upcoming SOC 2 scope and would like to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on evidence collection and architecture: encryption at-rest/in-transit, audit log retention and access, and SSO / IdP integration. Goal is to make sure we can map Redwood artifacts to our control set ahead of our audit in May.

Proposed attendees from our side: myself (Alex, Security Ops), Priya Kaur (App Security), and our compliance lead. Could you loop in whoever owns infra/security on your side? We’d like a 60–75 minute session with time for Q&A.

I’ve attached our initial questionnaire (Horizon_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) so you can see the level of detail we’ll need.

Available windows next week (EST):
- Tue 2/9 10:00–12:00
- Wed 2/10 14:00–17:00

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

Alex Chen
Security Operations
Horizon Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security deep-dive request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Looping in Vivek (security lead) and Naomi (customer success) so we have the right folks on the call.

We can do Tue 2/9 10:00–11:15 EST or Wed 2/10 15:00–16:15 EST. Proposed agenda (60–75m):
1) 20m — high-level architecture and where evidence lives (KV: keys, encryption)
2) 25m — audit logs & retention (what we capture, export options)
3) 15m — SSO / SCIM and identity flows
4) Q&A + next steps / evidence handoff

Pre-reads: I’ll upload our architecture diagram and an evidence inventory template. Can you confirm which window you prefer and whether your compliance lead will join?

Attaching: redwood-arch-diagram-v2.png (high level)

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@horizonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security deep-dive request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Tessa,

Apologies — one more ask before we lock the time: can you include a short list of the specific artifacts we should expect to collect (examples: key rotation logs, KMS access reports, system-level audit export examples)? The questionnaire is pretty broad — having a concrete checklist will help us prepare and reduce back-and-forth during the call.

We prefer Tue 2/9 10:00–11:15 EST if Vivek can make it. Our compliance lead will be on the call.

Thanks,
Alex
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security deep-dive request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Hi Alex / team — I’ll be on for Tue 2/9 10:00 EST. Quick note on artifacts we can prepare before the call (high-level):
- KMS key metadata & rotation policy (exportable CSV)
- Audit log samples (API request/response, admin actions) and retention options (30/90/365d)
- Role-based access control mappings and an export of current admin principals
- SSO configuration doc (SAML metadata, assertion attributes, SCIM provisioning guide)
- Network and encryption diagram + TLS configuration notes

I’m attaching our evidence inventory template (RI_evidence_inventory_template.xlsx) — please fill columns marked "Horizon requested" so we can stage exports if needed. If you can share the names of the controls you most need mapped (e.g., CC6.1 type), we’ll prioritize the artifacts.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Reliability
Redwood Inference

Quick update — I have a calendar conflict that came up for this morning. Can we move to Tue 2/9 16:00–17:15 EST instead (same day, later slot)? Vivek is still available and Naomi will host the invite if that works.

Apologies for the late shuffle — we want to make sure the right folks (Vivek) can lead the technical portion. If you need to keep morning, we can ask Vivek to take lead without me.

On artifacts: Vivek will start staging the KMS metadata and sample audit logs today. I’ll share the Drive folder after this thread.

Thanks,
Tessa

Also, note: we’ll need the SSO SAML metadata and a point of contact for SCIM provisioning work after the call. Can Vivek or someone own that thread?

Appreciate the quick coordination — see you all later today.
